Business Development Manager

Heb jij affiniteit met innovatieve optische- en meettechnologie en weet jij technische oplossingen te vertalen naar commerciële kansen? Krijg je daarnaast energie van het aanboren van nieuwe markten en het realiseren van groei? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als Business Development Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het stimuleren van de commerciële groei van onze Sensing Business in Europa. Je bent dé commerciële en interne gesprekspartner voor onze oplossingen op het gebied van licht-, display- en kleurmetingen. Je signaleert nieuwe marktkansen, ontwikkelt klantrelaties en helpt onze organisatie om onze positie binnen verschillende industrieën verder te versterken.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze salesteams, Marketing en de Europese Sensing-organisatie. Samen vertaal je ontwikkelingen in de markt en behoeften van klanten naar concrete commerciële mogelijkheden. Je opereert op Europees niveau, waarbij je regelmatig contact hebt met klanten en collega's in verschillende landen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen en realiseren van commerciële groeiplannen en omzetdoelstellingen voor de toegewezen markt en productportfolio's;

  • Actief identificeren van nieuwe marktkansen, potentiële klanten en strategische samenwerkingspartners.

  • Opbouwen, onderhouden en uitbreiden van relaties met bestaande klanten en partners binnen Europa.

  • Ontwikkelen van commerciële strategieën en proposities voor verschillende sectoren, waaronder automotive, manufacturing, food & agriculture, verlichting en displays, recycling, verf en kunststoffen.

  • Ondersteunen van de lokale salesteams bij het identificeren, kwalificeren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen.

  • Verzorgen en leiden van klantpresentaties, workshops, demonstraties en proof-of-concept trajecten.

  • Optreden als inhoudelijk en commercieel adviseur voor klanten gedurende het volledige verkooptraject.

  • Volgen van marktontwikkelingen, technologische innovaties en relevante wet- en regelgeving en deze vertalen naar commerciële kansen.

  • Opstellen en bewaken van commerciële plannen, forecasts en pipeline-ontwikkelingen en hierover rapporteren aan het management.

  • Nauw afstemmen met Europese collega's over nieuwe leads en commerciële trajecten, zodat kansen gezamenlijk en op de juiste manier worden opgepakt.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO-opleiding, bij voorkeur in een technische richting zoals Engineering, Natuurkunde of Scheikunde. Een bedrijfskundige opleiding in combinatie met sterke technische affiniteit is ook passend.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een commerciële functie binnen een technische B2B-omgeving, bijvoorbeeld in business development of technische sales.

  • Je hebt ervaring met industriële meettechnologie en bij voorkeur kennis van kleurmeting, spectrofotometrie, colorimetrie en licht- en displaymetingen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van nieuwe markten en het uitbouwen van strategische klantrelaties.

  • Je bent in staat om technische producteigenschappen te vertalen naar concrete klantbehoeften en commerciële oplossingen.

  • Je hebt een ondernemende instelling, ziet kansen en neemt initiatief om deze te benutten.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en hebt ervaring met het opstellen van commerciële plannen, forecast en businesscases.

  • Je bent communicatief vaardig en weet zowel technische specialisten als commerciële en managementstakeholders te overtuigen.

  • Je beheerst de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Beheersing van een andere Europese taal is een pré.

  • Je bent gewend om internationaal en met verschillende afdelingen en culturen samen te werken.

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om regelmatig te reizen binnen Europa.

Wat bieden we?

Een uitdagende, internationale functie binnen een innovatieve en groeiende business unit van een beursgenoteerde organisatie, waarin je volop ruimte krijgt om commerciële kansen te ontwikkelen en daadwerkelijk impact te maken.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris en een compleet pakket aan (secundaire) arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een prestatiegerichte bonusregeling.

  • Een zelfstandige en strategische rol met veel internationale contacten en verantwoordelijkheid.

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere Europese groei van onze Sensing Business Unit.

  • Een innovatieve werkomgeving met toegang tot hoogwaardige meettechnologie en een breed portfolio aan oplossingen.

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, trainingen en opleidingen.

  • Een collegiale werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en ondernemerschap centraal staan.

Wie zijn wij?

Konica Minolta is een internationaal bedrijf dat innovatieve oplossingen aan organisaties en de samenleving biedt. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Tokyo. Konica Minolta heeft haar groepsmaatschappijen in 50 landen met meer dan 35.000 werknemers. De organisatie biedt producten en diensten in 150 landen over de hele wereld.

Onze Mensen en Innovaties houden ons in beweging om onze business te versterken, continu ons motto 'Rethink and shape the future' toe te passen en de manier waarop mensen zakendoen en technologie inzetten te veranderen.

Iedere dag bij Konica Minolta is een kans om jouw Ideeën te delen, Verandering te stimuleren en samen te werken met collega's met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringen.

Together, we rethink today in order to shape the Future!

This opportunity resides with All-Domain Operations (ADO), a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All-Domain Operations comprises multi-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII-Mission Technologies All Domain Operations (ADO) Business Group is seeking a full time Business Developer. This can be a remote opportunity.

The ideal candidate should understand services type contract arrangements and acquisition life cycles, and understand the organizational structure and mission of the 11 Unified Combatant Commands in the Department of War, the Intelligence Community, the Department of State, the Department of Homeland Security, the Federal Emergency Management Agency, and other FEDCIV agencies.

The position requires confident, knowledgeable, and hands-on experience that works collaboratively with all stakeholders while staying focused on delivering a winning solution. You will perform market and economic analysis, conduct business intelligence, design, and execute formal capture plans, support marketing efforts, contribute to proposals, and monitor market and competitor activity.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Identifies and implements business development projects relating to professional services
  • Identifies, markets and determines the feasibility of product and service development.
  • Performs economic analyses on new or improved product opportunities and/or business models and coordinates with internal departments in identifying/implementing business development projects.
  • Works with sales, marketing, and potential customers to determine their needs.
  • Develops and disseminates information continuously to all pertinent parties concerning the fulfillment of project goals and objectives.
  • Develop and execute an account strategy and pipeline to win new business within DoW ADO market areas.
  • Identify, qualify, and win new business opportunities, with high Pwin potential, on prime contracts worth over $50M.
  • Build/maintain a robust qualified pipeline of opportunities that align with HII-Mission Technologies' strategic growth vision.
  • Develop and implement customer call plans for identified opportunities.
  • Assess the competitive landscape and lead the development and implementation of differentiated win strategies.
  • Lead and/or support in the negotiation of teaming agreements.
  • Engage customers in identifying and shaping potential opportunities using knowledge of the customer’s mission and challenges, company capabilities, client relationships and contract vehicles, to include GWACs, large MACs, and other alternative contract vehicles available across HII-Mission Technologies.
  • Lead the development of white papers, RFI, Market Surveys, and Sources Sought responses, as well as lead in-person meetings.
  • Develop and present bid/no bid recommendations and pursuit and capture strategies at Gate Reviews.
  • Support the capture and proposal development phases of the opportunity lifecycle by providing customer insights, solutions support, color review participation, and proposal writing, as required.
  • Represent ADO Group as the primary internal and external contact on new business pursuits.
  • Have regular interaction with high-level customer leadership and engage and collaborating visibly with internal business units.
  • Personally model HII values of integrity, safety, honesty, engagement, responsibility, and performance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 8 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 14 years relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of specific successful Business Development or Capture Management experience within the defense or federal market areas including but not limited to: Intelligence Analysis and Operations, Aviation Services, Global Logistics, Integrated Product Support, Modernization, Intelligence and Operations, Engineering Services and additional capability/market areas required to sustain manned and unmanned platforms. (Key Accounts include: Intelligence Community, Combatant and Component Commands, Army, Air Force, DoS, and DHS).
  • Successful BD experience must include Performing Long Term Positioning and Opportunity Assessment (as defined by Shipley Associates) resulting in a robust qualified pipeline of opportunities with proven transition of those opportunities to Capture Planning.
  • Five or more years of successful Program Management experience as a Program Manager or Deputy Program Manager within the defense or federal market areas including but not limited to: Intelligence Analysis and Operations, Aviation Services, Global Logistics, Integrated Product Support, Modernization, Intelligence and Operations, Engineering Services and additional capability/market areas required to sustain manned and unmanned platforms. (Key Accounts include: Intelligence Community, Combatant and Component Commands, Army, Air Force, DoS and DHS).
  • Established and extensive customer relationships with relevant senior and mid-level leadership in DoW or federal customers.
  • Proven ability to form strategic industry partnerships and possess existing relationships with large and small businesses in the federal and commercial market.
  • Ability to learn, be proactive, manage multiple tasks, and have a demonstrated technical/business GovCon acumen.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with senior leadership.
  • A willingness to be a good teammate, working collaboratively and across borders to further company goals.
  • Ability to communicate with the end users and discuss capabilities-based solutions to meet their requirements.
  • Ability to travel as required to develop opportunity pipelines, shape opportunities, maintain customer relationships, and attend industry days and conferences.
  • Tenure and staying power at a company or organization.
  • Clearance- Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a clearance.

Preferred Requirements

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification from the Program Management Institute.
  • Top Secret clearance.
  • P&L or military acquisition program or product management experience (understanding the process, structure, and framework of how the USG makes acquisition decisions for products and services).
  • Understand FEDSIM and IAC vehicles as well the MILDEPs and GCCs.
  • Have a portfolio of wins or depth in pulling opportunities from a concept to a contract with a client.

If you are passionate about making a difference and thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we invite you to apply to join our team.

This role will focus on strategically targeting Federal agencies such as the United States Army, the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), Navy, Airforce, Department of Justice, Department of Energy, the United States Space Command, Customs and Border Patrol in the Department of Homeland Security. As the Business Development Professional, the individual will be instrumental in identifying, rigorously qualifying, and successfully closing new business opportunities. (Remote and will be required to travel at least 25%)

  • Establishes and maintains trusted relationships with DoD and Government decision-makers, industry partners, and integrators
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with internal departments and leadership teams to ensure customer success

  • Contributes to the evolution of BD processes, including CRM, formal capture, and proposal workflows
  • Responsible for developing, forecasting, and capturing new opportunities and maintaining relationships with new and existing customers
  • Identifies strategic inflection points in the marketplace for core and non-traditional business initiatives
  • Develops and presents compelling strategic and business growth opportunities that may include market and competitive analysis
  • Monitors key government portals, notices and postings on a daily basis to identify strategic and tactical fit opportunities for Go/No-Go consideration

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a High School Diploma or equivalent
  • 10 or more years’ experience working in the Federal IT industry
  • Must have the ability to develop and maintain relationships with the customer
  • Prior experience and relationships with the Federal IT industry with the ability to translate OSC’s capabilities into growth opportunities
  • Providing capture planning and execution support for operational and strategic opportunities
  • Has strong relationships in target accounts
  • Working the full range of opportunities tactical, operational and strategic opportunities
  • Proven ability and demonstrated success in capturing small and large-scale DoD contracts, preferably in information technology
  • Strong knowledge of POM processes and contracting vehicles (e.g., IDIQ)
  • Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess market conditions, competition, and customer needs
  • Ability to provide business case development and opportunity shaping for future growth
  • Must have prior relationship building with federal acquisition offices, as well as prior experience working and collaborating with subcontractor and prime Federal Contractors
  • Capability to multitask and handle competing deadlines
  • Demonstrated strategic approaches to entering markets
  • Approachable demeanor and strong motivation to go above and beyond
  • Ability to make sound judgments and decisions in the best interest of the company
  • Ability to be resourceful and solve problems quickly and at times work under pressure

grmc Advisory Services is a uniquely positioned business advisory consultancy providing informed market insight through intensive research activity. Based in Riyadh & Dubai with 25 years of experience in the Gulf region. We play an increasingly vital role in the region, advising leading private and public institutions in core sectors including real estate development, retail operations & development, healthcare operations & development, production and manufacturing operations & development, education operations & development and socio-economic environment & future outlook. Our clients comprise of MNCs, governments & institutions, regional & international businesses, SME’s, and other consultant entities. We work with our clients to develop strategy and we typically provide informed market reports pursuant to feasibility, business planning and strategic market understanding, to know more please visit

1. ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Manager to drive growth across India. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the company’s strategic expansion within the market research, advisory, and consulting space.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITES

  • Research and identify new business opportunities across India (including Tier 1, Tier 2, and emerging markets) to support the Company’s growth strategy.

  • Drive revenue growth by adopting a client-first sales approach and delivering tailored solutions aligned with client needs.

  • Conduct sector-specific and industry analysis (e.g., BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, Infrastructure, Technology) to identify high-potential opportunities.

  • Collaborate with leadership to develop mid- and long-term business development strategies and support execution to achieve sales targets.

  • Develop and execute marketing initiatives, thought leadership content, and sales collateral to strengthen the Company’s brand positioning in India.

  • Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with clients, positioning the Company as a trusted advisory and consulting partner.

  • Identify client needs and proactively recommend research, advisory, and consulting solutions that add measurable value.

  • Prepare and deliver compelling business proposals, ensuring alignment with client requirements and pre-qualification criteria.

  • Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, policy changes, and economic developments in India, providing strategic insights to senior management.

  • Develop and maintain a robust database of key decision-makers, stakeholders, and upcoming project opportunities across industries.

  • Strengthen relationships with existing clients while expanding engagement across new business units and departments.

  • Represent the Company at industry events, conferences, seminars, and networking forums to generate leads and enhance brand visibility.

  • Review and analyze Requests for Proposals (RFPs), assessing project scope, feasibility, timelines, profitability, and client credibility.

  • Support leadership in the preparation and execution of the Company’s India business plan and growth strategy.

  • Drive go-to-market strategies and support the launch of new service offerings within the Indian market.

  • Manage sales pipeline, track opportunities, and provide accurate sales forecasts.

  • Lead new business acquisition efforts, including engaging with corporate clients, government bodies, and institutional stakeholders.

  • Coordinate and manage project onboarding for new clients, ensuring smooth transition from sales to delivery teams.

  • Oversee multiple proposal processes simultaneously, ensuring timely and high-quality submissions.

SUMMARY

The Business Development Leader is responsible for executing a Business Unit’s growth strategy, with primary accountability for driving revenue growth, expanding market presence, and building a strong pipeline of new and repeat business. Working closely with the Business Unit Leader, the Business Development Leader aligns departmental growth strategies with overall business unit objectives and contributes to long-term market positioning.

The Business Development Leader is accountable for achieving individual and team sales, revenue, multiplier, and profitability goals as outlined in the annual business plan, through new client acquisition, opportunity development, and strategic client relationship management. The role is entirely focused on front-end growth activities, including identifying target clients and markets, leading pursuits, strengthening key client relationships, and advancing opportunities through the sales pipeline.

The Business Development Leader has no direct operational or project delivery responsibilities. Project execution and day-to-day operational management are led by delivery and operations leadership. The Business Development Leader may engage at a high level to support client relationships or business development outcomes. The Business Development Leader serves as the first point of escalation for significant client-related matters that may impact business development, working in coordination with the Business Unit Leader and operational leaders as needed

Business Development

  • Achieve individual and Business Unit sales and revenue goals as defined in the annual business plan.
  • Develop and implement client capture plans for strategic accounts and major pursuits.
  • Identify, cultivate, and close opportunities with new clients while expanding services and relationships with existing clients.
  • Serve as the primary pursuit leader, guiding go/no-go decisions, pursuit strategies, and teaming approaches in alignment with Business Unit priorities.
  • Leverage personal, client, industry, and teaming partner networks to generate and convert business development opportunities that provide a competitive advantage.
  • Build a strong brand for the Department through personal and team promotion in the industry.

Client Acquisition & Management

  • Build and maintain strong, multi-level relationships with strategic clients and prospects, serving as the senior relationship lead during the business development and pursuit phases.
  • Strengthen Burns’ market presence by establishing trusted advisor relationships with client decision-makers and influencers.
  • Ensure smooth transition of awarded work and established client relationships to delivery leadership, while remaining engaged at a strategic level to support ongoing growth and repeat business.
  • Serve as the first point of escalation for significant client-related issues that may impact future business opportunities or long-term client relationships, partnering with the Business Unit Leader and operational leadership as appropriate.
  • Ensure negotiated contracts with potential and existing clients are favorable terms and in compliance with Burns practice of protecting the company.
  • Support client engagement related to change order approvals and accounts receivable recovery by addressing client-side issues that may delay revenue realization or payment.

Financial & Risk Management

Compliance

  • Adhere to all Human Resources policies and procedures.
  • Partner with Human Resources Business Partner to ensure adherence to all federal, state, and local employment regulations.
  • Complete special duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The Business Development Leader will not have any direct reports.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s (B.S.) degree, preferably in Engineering or Business Management, from an accredited university or college is strongly preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in business development, sales, or strategic growth roles, including leadership responsibility for revenue generation and client acquisition.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing business development strategies, leading complex pursuits, and achieving revenue growth.

  • Represent Activate Collision Solutions with credibility and authority in client-facing forums, senior reviews, external events, strategic planning sessions and as required.

Client retention and development:

Job Description

Position Summary

The Strategic Business Development Advisor is responsible for developing and executing territory and account engagement strategies that expand Galvanize's presence within Enterprise and Government markets. This role exercises independent judgment in identifying market opportunities, prioritizing target accounts, developing prospect engagement strategies, qualifying business opportunities, and advising internal stakeholders on market trends, customer needs, and pipeline development. The position collaborates closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Strategic Account Advisors to optimize business development initiatives and improve sales effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Pipeline Development

  • Develop and execute territory-specific prospecting and account engagement strategies aligned with organizational revenue objectives.
  • Analyze target markets, industry trends, customer initiatives, competitive activity, and organizational priorities to identify high-value business opportunities.
  • Determine outreach priorities and engagement approaches based on independent assessment of account potential, buying readiness, and strategic fit.
  • Design and adapt multi-channel engagement strategies utilizing email, phone, LinkedIn, referrals, events, and other approved business development channels.
  • Evaluate campaign effectiveness and modify outreach strategies to improve engagement and conversion rates.

Business Opportunity Assessment

  • Conduct consultative discovery conversations to evaluate organizational priorities, workforce challenges, AI initiatives, budget considerations, and strategic objectives.
  • Exercise independent judgment in determining opportunity qualification, sales readiness, stakeholder alignment, and appropriate next steps.
  • Identify business risks, obstacles, and competitive considerations while recommending strategies to advance opportunities.
  • Develop account intelligence and strategic recommendations that enable successful engagement by Strategic Account Advisors.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership by providing market intelligence, customer feedback, and recommendations for improving business development effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to refine messaging, campaign strategy, and target audience segmentation.
  • Recommend improvements to business development processes, sales workflows, qualification methodology, and CRM utilization.
  • Participate in planning discussions regarding territory development, market expansion, and pipeline forecasting.

Pipeline Management & Business Analysis

  • Maintain responsibility for the quality, health, and strategic direction of assigned business development pipeline.
  • Analyze pipeline performance, conversion metrics, and engagement effectiveness to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Prepare reports and communicate market observations, business risks, opportunity forecasts, and pipeline insights to leadership.
  • Ensure CRM records accurately reflect strategic account information, customer needs, opportunity status, and recommended actions.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, consultative sales, recruiting, or a related client-facing business role.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize work, manage territory strategy, and exercise sound business judgment.
  • Experience analyzing customer organizations and developing strategic engagement plans.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to executive and senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience using CRM systems, sales engagement platforms, and business productivity software.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities and competing business objectives.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing Enterprise or Government accounts.
  • Knowledge of public-sector procurement, workforce development, professional services, or technology solutions.
  • Understanding of AI adoption, workforce transformation, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success functions.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
